```python
import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import cv2


def default_result():
    return {
        "type": "other",
        "description": "无法确定图片类型",
        "important_components": [],
        "code_relevant_information": ""
    }


def extract_visual_features(img):
    h, w = img.shape[:2]
    gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
    hsv = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2HSV)

    total_px = float(h * w)

    white_ratio = float(np.sum(gray > 200)) / total_px
    dark_ratio = float(np.sum(gray < 80)) / total_px

    sat = hsv[:, :, 1].astype(np.float64)
    sat_mean = float(np.mean(sat))
    sat_std = float(np.std(sat))

    hue = hsv[:, :, 0].astype(np.float64)
    colored_mask = sat > 50
    colored_ratio = float(np.sum(colored_mask)) / total_px

    if np.sum(colored_mask) > 10:
        colored_hues = hue[colored_mask]
        hist, _ = np.histogram(colored_hues, bins=18, range=(0, 180))
        hist = hist.astype(np.float64)
        hist /= max(np.sum(hist), 1e-9)
        hue_entropy = -float(np.sum(hist[hist > 0] * np.log2(hist[hist > 0])))
    else:
        hue_entropy = 0.0

    ds_size = 320
    ds = cv2.resize(gray, (min(w, ds_size), min(h, ds_size)))
    ds_h, ds_w = ds.shape
    block_size = 16
    variances = []
    for by in range(0, ds_h - block_size + 1, block_size):
        for bx in range(0, ds_w - block_size + 1, block_size):
            block = ds[by:by + block_size, bx:bx + block_size].astype(np.float64)
            variances.append(np.var(block))
    avg_block_var = float(np.mean(variances)) if variances else 0.0

    grad_y = np.abs(cv2.Sobel(gray, cv2.CV_64F, 0, 1, ksize=3))
    grad_x = np.abs(cv2.Sobel(gray, cv2.CV_64F, 1, 0, ksize=3))
    h_line_score = float(np.mean(grad_y > 30))
    v_line_score = float(np.mean(grad_x > 30))
    line_score = h_line_score + v_line_score

    b_mean = float(np.mean(img[:, :, 0]))
    g_mean = float(np.mean(img[:, :, 1]))
    r_mean = float(np.mean(img[:, :, 2]))

    sat_vals_flat = hsv[:, :, 1].flatten()
    hue_vals_flat = hsv[:, :, 0].flatten()
    pure_blue = float(np.sum((sat_vals_flat > 120) & (hue_vals_flat > 100) & (hue_vals_flat < 130))) / total_px
    pure_red = float(np.sum((sat_vals_flat > 120) & ((hue_vals_flat < 10) | (hue_vals_flat > 170)))) / total_px
    pure_green = float(np.sum((sat_vals_flat > 120) & (hue_vals_flat > 35) & (hue_vals_flat < 85))) / total_px
    pure_orange = float(np.sum((sat_vals_flat > 120) & (hue_vals_flat > 10) & (hue_vals_flat < 25))) / total_px
    distinct_pure_color_count = sum(1 for c in [pure_blue, pure_red, pure_green, pure_orange] if c > 0.003)

    bright_colored = float(np.sum((sat > 80) & (hsv[:, :, 2] > 80))) / total_px

    return {
        "white_ratio": white_ratio,
        "dark_ratio": dark_ratio,
        "sat_mean": sat_mean,
        "sat_std": sat_std,
        "colored_ratio": colored_ratio,
        "hue_entropy": hue_entropy,
        "avg_block_var": avg_block_var,
        "h_line_score": h_line_score,
        "v_line_score": v_line_score,
        "line_score": line_score,
        "b_mean": b_mean,
        "g_mean": g_mean,
        "r_mean": r_mean,
        "distinct_pure_color_count": distinct_pure_color_count,
        "bright_colored_ratio": bright_colored
    }


def classify(features, ocr_text=""):
    scores = {
        "architecture": 0.0,
        "experiment_result": 0.0,
        "dataset": 0.0,
        "other": 0.0
    }

    ocr_upper = ocr_text.upper() if ocr_text else ""

    arch_keywords = [
        "CNN", "TRANSFORMER", "ATTENTION", "ENCODER", "DECODER",
        "BLOCK", "EMBEDDING", "CLASSIFIER", "FEATURE EXTRACTOR",
        "ALEXNET", "RESNET", "VGG", "GOOGLENET", "LENET",
        "CONVOLUTION", "POOLING", "LAYER", "NETWORK", "MODEL",
        "FORWARD", "BACKBONE", "HEAD", "NECK", "FPN", "BERT",
        "GPT", "LSTM", "GRU", "RNN", "LAYER NORM", "FEED FORWARD"
    ]

    exp_keywords = [
        "ACCURACY", "LOSS", "EPOCH", "PRECISION", "RECALL",
        "F1", "RESULT", "COMPARISON", "BENCHMARK", "TABLE",
        "TRAINING", "VALIDATION", "TEST", "PERFORMANCE", "CURVE",
        "METRIC", "AUC", "ROC", "MAP", "IOU", "TOP-1", "TOP-5",
        "LATENCY", "THROUGHPUT", "PARAM", "FLOPS", "STATE-OF-THE-ART",
        "CONVERGE", "ABLATION"
    ]

    ds_keywords = [
        "DATASET", "SAMPLE", "CLASS", "INPUT", "IMAGE",
        "DATA", "MNIST", "CIFAR", "IMAGENET", "COCO",
        "PASCAL", "VOC", "OVERVIEW", "EXAMPLES"
    ]

    for kw in arch_keywords:
        if kw in ocr_upper:
            scores["architecture"] += 2.0

    for kw in exp_keywords:
        if kw in ocr_upper:
            scores["experiment_result"] += 2.5

    for kw in ds_keywords:
        if kw in ocr_upper:
            scores["dataset"] += 2.0

    f = features

    if f["white_ratio"] > 0.45:
        scores["architecture"] += 2.0
        scores["experiment_result"] += 1.5
    elif f["white_ratio"] > 0.30:
        scores["architecture"] += 1.0
        scores["experiment_result"] += 1.0
    elif f["white_ratio"] < 0.20:
        scores["dataset"] += 1.5

    if f["distinct_pure_color_count"] >= 2 and f["white_ratio"] > 0.25:
        scores["experiment_result"] += 2.5
    if f["distinct_pure_color_count"] >= 3 and f["white_ratio"] > 0.20:
        scores["experiment_result"] += 1.5

    if f["dark_ratio"] > 0.01 and f["dark_ratio"] < 0.15:
        scores["experiment_result"] += 1.0
        scores["architecture"] += 0.5

    if 1.5 < f["hue_entropy"] < 3.8 and f["white_ratio"] > 0.25:
        scores["experiment_result"] += 1.5
    if f["hue_entropy"] > 3.5 and f["white_ratio"] < 0.35:
        scores["dataset"] += 2.5

    if f["sat_mean"] > 65 and f["colored_ratio"] > 0.30:
        scores["dataset"] += 2.5
    if f["sat_mean"] < 80 and f["white_ratio"] > 0.35:
        scores["architecture"] += 1.5
    if 15 < f["sat_mean"] < 120 and f["white_ratio"] > 0.30:
        scores["experiment_result"] += 1.0

    if f["avg_block_var"] > 3500:
        scores["dataset"] += 1.5
    if f["avg_block_var"] < 2500:
        scores["architecture"] += 1.0

    if f["line_score"] > 0.15 and f["white_ratio"] > 0.30:
        scores["experiment_result"] += 1.5
        scores["architecture"] += 1.0

    if f["bright_colored_ratio"] > 0.25 and f["white_ratio"] < 0.40:
        scores["dataset"] += 1.5

    if f["white_ratio"] > 0.60 and f["colored_ratio"] < 0.15:
        scores["architecture"] += 2.0

    max_score = max(scores.values())

    if max_score <= 1.8:
        return "other", "", [], ""

    priority_order = ["experiment_result", "architecture", "dataset", "other"]
    for ptype in priority_order:
        if scores[ptype] >= max_score - 0.01:
            if ptype == "experiment_result":
                desc = "展示实验结果、性能对比或训练曲线"
                comps = []
                comp_words = ocr_upper.split()
                known_models = [
                    "ALEXNET", "RESNET", "VGG", "GOOGLENET", "BERT",
                    "TRANSFORMER", "LSTM", "CNN", "GPT", "MOBILENET",
                    "DENSENET", "INCEPTION", "EFFICIENTNET", "YOLO",
                    "UNET", "GNN"
                ]
                known_metrics = [
                    "ACCURACY", "LOSS", "PRECISION", "RECALL", "F1",
                    "AUC", "MAP", "IOU", "TOP-1", "TOP-5", "FLOPS",
                    "LATENCY", "PARAMS"
                ]
                for m in known_models:
                    if m in ocr_upper:
                        comps.append(m)
                for m in known_metrics:
                    if m in ocr_upper:
                        comps.append(m)
                comps = list(dict.fromkeys(comps))
                code_info = "需要实现模型训练、评估指标计算和实验结果可视化"
                return ptype, desc, comps, code_info

            elif ptype == "architecture":
                desc = "展示模型网络结构和数据流关系"
                comps = []
                known_models = [
                    "ALEXNET", "RESNET", "VGG", "GOOGLENET", "BERT",
                    "TRANSFORMER", "LSTM", "CNN", "GPT", "MOBILENET",
                    "DENSENET", "INCEPTION", "EFFICIENTNET", "YOLO",
                    "UNET", "GNN", "ATTENTION", "ENCODER", "DECODER",
                    "EMBEDDING", "CLASSIFIER", "FEATURE EXTRACTOR"
                ]
                for m in known_models:
                    if m in ocr_upper:
                        comps.append(m)
                comps = list(dict.fromkeys(comps))
                code_info = "需要根据图中网络结构实现对应的模型组件和前向传播逻辑"
                return ptype, desc, comps, code_info

            elif ptype == "dataset":
                desc = "展示数据集样本或类别示例"
                code_info = "需要实现数据加载、预处理和增强流程"
                return ptype, desc, [], code
